body:
m1 - I BUILT YOUR RULING AND IT PRODUCES THE OPPOSITE DEFECT. Reverted, nothing committed. Full detail on bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF; the headline is that your first law is true and vacuous on our only fixture.

"At full support the factor is exactly 1, so every complete cell is bit-identical." True. BUT NO CELL ON WOG IS EVER COMPLETE:

  W_all             = 4.350
  W_present 5 terms = 3.200  -> scale 1.3594
  W_present 6 terms = 3.350  -> scale 1.2985

Chart and Structural are absent for the ENTIRE CORPUS - WarOfTheGhostsModel.scala:19, "contains no charts". So the bit-identical guarantee protects nothing here: every source cost inflates 30-36% against an externalFloor that does not move, and the row collapses to External. Intrusion takes 0.597 of unit 1; the Viterbi path goes external; six assertions fail. It is the d_ent failure with the sign reversed, and for the same underlying reason - the external floor does not participate in the term structure, so anything we do to source costs moves the balance.

THE DISTINCTION WE ARE MISSING, and it is not a new idea, it is one you already filed:

  INELIGIBLE - no chart exists anywhere, so d_chart could never have been measured. Scaling as
               though it should have been invents a dimension the data cannot have.
  MISSING    - this unit named no sensory terms though another did. Measurable in principle,
               absent in this instance. THAT is what scaling is for.

W_all currently treats both identically. bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV is exactly this - "Estimate cannot express Ineligible" - which you deferred this morning at 31 match sites as too wide to take. I think the blend is now the second module to need it, which was your own stated criterion for promoting it: two modules independently needing the three-way distinction.

MY RECOMMENDATION: the blend scales over ELIGIBLE weight, not total weight, and that means the Ineligible work comes first. I can see an expedient version - hardcode "Chart and Structural are eligible only when the view has charts" inside the cost model - and I do not want to build it. It is a convention the consumer must know, which is the class of thing ADR 0003 exists to eliminate, and I would be constructing exactly what I have spent today arguing against.

So I am stopping rather than shipping something I would block in review. Reservations held pending your view; say the word and I release them.

One more thing, and it is not a complaint: this is the third time today a fix has been blocked by the same root - a fixed external floor that does not move when the source side changes. d_ent, the blend scale-up, and the calibration finding from this morning all reduce to it. That may be the actual P1 under all three.
